text:
Mei Chen: Customer reports the Redwood Console hangs when they hit Save on routing rules. UI shows spinner ~10s then toast: "Save failed". Browser: Chrome 116 on macOS 13. Client could not find an obvious request-id in the UI. Can someone share exact repro capture steps we can send?

Sam Patel: Thanks Mei. Ask them for a HAR export + console logs. Typical minimal instructions: open DevTools (Cmd+Opt+I), go to Network tab, check 'Preserve log', reproduce the issue, then right-click -> 'Save all as HAR with content'. Also capture Console panel: right-click -> Save as... or copy all.

Alex Rivera: Add a curl repro as well — if the HAR shows an X-Request-ID or response status. Example to replay the failing request (replace headers/body from HAR):
```bash
curl -v \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -H "x-request-id: <paste-x-request-id>" \n  -d '{"routes": [...]} ' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/console/routes/save
```
Mention to scrub any API keys before sending the HAR.

Jordan: Also request these fields in the support reply: user account id (customer org id), time of the attempt (timezone), browser console error text (copy/paste), full HAR file, and a quick screen recording (optional). Provide a secure upload link for the debug bundle and ask them not to post HAR in public.

Mei Chen: I'll message the customer with the checklist. Quick note: how do we want them to name the HAR and logs?

Sam Patel: Suggest: <org>-console-save-har-YYYYMMDD.zip. Inside: har.har, console.txt, screenshot.png, steps.txt. Also include a one-liner for privacy: redact Authorization header or replace with <REDACTED>.

eng-bot: If the HAR shows a 5xx from api.redwood.ai then tag @eng-runtime and include the x-request-id header.

ops-bot: Deploy notice: v2.14.1 rolling to prod in 20m — if this is during deploy window, note potential transient errors. :information_source:

Alex Rivera: If they can't share a HAR, ask for Network tab export of the single failing request: right-click -> Copy -> Copy as cURL, paste results. That lets us replay without full HAR.

Jordan: Also give them this one-liner to grab console logs quickly (mac Chrome):
```bash
open -a "Google Chrome" --args --enable-logging --v=1
# Or from DevTools Console: right click -> Save as...
```

Mei Chen: Sending now. Will tag back when customer uploads. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
